justifications.evidence: logs/head-3.log ends mid-run with no summary and no EXIT= line although the manifest records 88 passed for that chunk, and logs/ruff-check.log predates the style commit showing an F401 the head no longer has.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:548 follows the module's Mapping-typed helper style and the added names carry no plan or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:548 lane_family is the one owner and :625 _ask_excluding_lane the one shared helper, read at :590 and :696 and called from recovery_review_dispatch.py:1472-1473 and picker/snapshot.py:928.

justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat d6ea082d..153e79c44 lists only the five declared files, each inside the manifest's write paths, plus the declared evidence fragment.
